Innovation Firm Secures Toll Collection Contract in Andhra Pradesh

A private company called Innovision has won a contract to collect tolls at the Vaddupalli fee plaza in Andhra Pradesh. The contract is worth ₹27.52 crore and includes one-year toll collection and maintenance services. This development may impact the local economy and infrastructure projects.
